status: registered before execution; G-L1 stage S1/S2-lite: projector-only alignment of OlmoEarth single-observation tokens into Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, trained on label-derived temporal QA from training regions, evaluated on QA v0.1 test items
llm: allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct (bf16, frozen; LoRA off in this gate)
eo_tokens: per date: OlmoEarth v1 base single-observation embedding 768x32x32 -> 4x4 average pool -> 64 tokens; for two dates: 64 (d1) + 64 (d2) + 64 (d2-d1) = 192 tokens; each passed through a 2-layer MLP projector 768->2048->hidden, with a learned per-slot type embedding (d1/d2/delta) and the date as text
prompt: same question strings as sentinel_qa_v0_1 with <video> replaced by the EO token span; answer supervised with LM cross-entropy on the answer tokens only
train_data: items generated by sentinel_qa_gen.py from Sen12 regions {chimanimani, thrissur, hokkaido, itogon, kyrgyzstan1, kyrgyzstan2, newzealand, china} (test regions hiroshima/indonesia excluded); Q1 gap-matched balanced, Q3, Q4; only tiles with single_fp16 available
eval: sentinel_qa_v0_1 items with single_fp16 available (same subset as the template baseline, n=384 Q1 / 192 Q3 / 192 Q4); registered regex parsing
training: AdamW 1e-4 on projector only, 3 epochs, batch 8, bf16, GPU0; seed 1 (seeds 2-3 only if seed 1 passes)

baselines_to_beat.text_only: same LLM, same prompt with EO tokens removed (dates and region name only) — trained the same way; must be run

decision_rules.G-L1_pass: Q1 balanced accuracy > .581 AND > text-only + .05 AND Q3 Jaccard > .54, parse-failure < 10%
decision_rules.G-L1_fail: otherwise: L track paused; report numbers
